_README: Every recurring, dated obligation the packet tracks. calendar.py expands each of these into concrete dated instances from the provider's cycle_start, so the provider sees not just WHAT is required but WHEN it is due and whether it is overdue. Frequencies: annual, semiannual, quarterly, monthly, per_hire, per_separation, per_event, per_person, continuous, once_before_survey. shift_specific=true multiplies by the number of shifts that deliver service.

obligations.item: Governing body meeting held, minutes recorded
obligations.evidence: Signed minutes showing attendance, quorum, decisions

obligations.item: Governing body reviews performance and quality data
Conflict of interest disclosures collected from every board member and leader
Governing body self-assessment completed and results acted on
Written evaluation of the CEO against stated expectations
Leadership meeting held, minutes recorded with decisions and owners
Code of Ethics signed by every person working for the agency
obligations.evidence: Signed attestation per person, dated within 12 months

obligations.item: Organizational chart reviewed and re-dated
Succession plan reviewed
Cultural Competency and Diversity Plan reviewed; objectives set from a demographic gap analysis

obligations.item: Environmental scan completed and documented
obligations.evidence: Completed Environmental Scan Worksheet with dates and sources

obligations.item: Strategic plan reviewed; progress against each objective documented
obligations.evidence: Dated plan + minutes recording the review

obligations.item: Leadership reviews strategic plan progress
Satisfaction survey issued to persons served

obligations.item: Satisfaction survey issued to other stakeholders (referral sources, payers, partners, families, staff)

obligations.item: Facilitated listening session or focus group with persons served

Bomb threat drill or documented tabletop

Record review findings discussed individually in supervision
Every prior-quarter finding verified as corrected, not just promised

obligations.item: Master Document Register reviewed: anything overdue for review, approved but never trained, or in use but never tested

obligations.item: Implementation tracer on one process: document, what staff say, what they can demonstrate, what records show, what the data shows
obligations.evidence: Completed Implementation Tracer Record with the layers compared
obligations.note: This is how a surveyor works. Running it on yourself first is the cheapest finding you will ever buy.
